Updating the desktop `#traceSelect` overrides so they beat `.visually-hidden !important`, and making the width-fit JS set width with `important`.

The desktop **Select trajectory** dropdown was effectively invisible.

**Cause:** The mobile overflow fix made `.visually-hidden` use `!important` on `width` and `border`. Desktop `#traceSelect` overrides for those properties did not, so the native select stayed 1px wide with no border while the mobile trigger stayed hidden.

**Fix:** Desktop `#traceSelect` now overrides `width`, `border`, and `max-width` with `!important`, and `fitTraceSelectWidth()` sets width with `important` so option-fitting still works.

<user_query>
does the CI/CD has automatic deployment now?
</user_query>

Yes. **Deploy** (`.github/workflows/deploy.yml`) publishes to Cloud Run automatically on every push to `main`, and you can also run it manually via **workflow_dispatch**.

It uses Workload Identity Federation (OIDC), so no GCP JSON key secret is required. Feature branches / PRs do not auto-deploy; only `main` does.
